# **YouTube Automation Strategy Guide**

# **1\. Key Performance Metrics**

* **CTR (Click-Through Rate):** The percentage of viewers who click on your video thumbnail after seeing it.  
* **AVD (Average View Duration):** The average total time (in minutes/seconds) viewers spend watching a video.  
* **AVP (Average Percentage Viewed):** The percentage of the total video length that the average viewer completes.  
* **Viewer Satisfaction:** Metrics such as likes, shares, comments, and survey responses indicating viewer feedback.

# **2\. Niche Strategy & Selection**

## **Niche Definitions**

| Term | Definition |
| :---- | :---- |
| Broad Niche | Generalised topic (basketball, Call of Duty, cooking, history) |
| Subniche | Specific focus (basketball highlights, COD patch notes, world history) |
| Niche Pool | Total videos in a niche. (e.g., 3 channels with 10 videos each \= 30 in the pool) |

## **Research & Channel Age**

| Metric | Target / Recommendation |
| :---- | :---- |
| Ideal Channel Age | Less than 6 months old (check sort by oldest) |
| 1 Week Performance | S+ Tier |
| 1 Month Performance | Great |
| 3 Months Performance | Average |

# **3\. Team & Workflow**

## **Team Roles**

| Role | Primary Task |
| :---- | :---- |
| Script Writer | Writes the script for the video |
| Voice-over Artist | Speak the script with the right emotion. |
| Video Editor | Edit the video into a final product. |
| Thumbnail Artist | Design high-converting thumbnails. |

## **AI Tool Stack**

| Category | Recommended Tools |
| :---- | :---- |
| Voice-over | ElevenLabs |
| Scripting | ChatGPT, Subscribe |
| Video Generation | Runway ML, Haiper, Sora, Kling AI |
| Stock Footage | Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash |
| Video Editing | CapCut |

# **4\. Audience Retention Targets**

| Video Length | Target AVD (Good / Great) |
| :---- | :---- |
| 8 minutes | 45% / 50% |
| 15 minutes | 40% / 45% |
| 30 minutes | 35% / 40% |
| 60 minutes | 30% / 35% |
| 120 minutes | 25% / 30% |

# **5\. Thumbnail psychology**

* **Add curiosity:** Leave an open question or show an exciting climax moment to prompt clicks.  
* **Emotion:** Faces displaying strong emotional expressions strongly capture viewer attention.  
* **Clarity:** Ensure viewers immediately understand the topic at a single glance.  
* **High contrast:** Utilize bright colors alongside dark shadows for strong visual punch.  
* **Minimal text:** Limit thumbnail copy to a maximum of 3–5 high-impact words.  
* **Leverage authority:** Feature recognizable figures or brand logos (e.g., Cristiano Ronaldo, Apple) to build instant trust.  
* **Mini-story:** Design visuals to convey a quick narrative arc or contrast.

## **Catchy Titles & Formulas**

* **Superlatives:** Use powerful adjectives (e.g., best, worst, biggest, fastest).  
* *Example:* The Most INSANE Tech Inventions of 2025\!  
* **Curiosity Gap:** Leave details mysterious or open-ended.  
* *Example:* Nobody Told You This About Passive Income...  
* **Fear or Urgency (FOMO):** Highlight a potential risk or loss of opportunity.  
* *Example:* Why Your Savings Account Is Making You Poor  
* **Direct Personal Address:** Speak directly to the viewer.  
* *Example:* Why YOU Still Haven't Hit 10K Subscribers  
* **Contrast & Paradox:** Present an unexpected pairing or contradiction.  
* *Example:* Why Smart People Make Dumb Decisions  
* **Emotion Words:** Incorporate words like 'secret', 'banned', 'dangerous', or 'hidden'.  
* *Example:* The BANNED YouTube Growth Strategy You Should Know  
* **Concise & Direct:** Keep copy short and punchy by eliminating filler words.  
* *Example:* This Mistake is KILLING Your YouTube Channel  
* **Brackets & Dashes:** Add structure and callouts for added clarity.  
* *Example:* How to Make Money on YouTube (Even With 0 Subscribers\!)  
* **Clear Promise:** State exactly what benefit or outcome the viewer will receive.  
* *Example:* How to Get 100K Views in 30 Days (Step-by-Step)

Title Category Breakdown & Inspiration

| Category | Focus | Title Examples |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Superlative** | Best, worst, biggest, most extreme | • The World's Worst Advice About Losing Weight • The Best Travel Destinations You've Never Heard Of • The World's Most Unusual Food • The World's Best Smartphone You Can Actually Afford • 10 Reasons a 9-to-5 is the Worst Choice Ever |
| **Secret / Mystery** | Revealing hidden or unknown information | • The Hidden Truth About Elon Musk • 10 Secrets The Fitness Experts Don't Want You to Know • The Secret of Successful Teenagers • Little Known Ways To Get More Views • 10 Myths About Sleep That You Still Believe |
| **Angst / Fear** | Evoking fear, warnings, or urgency | • 10 Relationship Mistakes You're Making Without Realizing • The Untold Dangers Of AI • 10 Reasons Not To Buy a Home • 10 Health Things You Should Never Do • Beware Of These 10 Habits |
